title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #2 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #2 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which verse says that nothing is impossible with God? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 7:14
   B. Luke 19:5
   C. Luke 15:8
   D. Luke 1:37

2. Which angel appeared to Mary? (1 mark)
   A. Raphael
   B. Peter
   C. Gabriel
   D. Michael

3. What does "forerunner" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A teacher of maths
   B. One who follows behind
   C. A king
   D. One who goes before to prepare

4. What was Zechariah's job? (1 mark)
   A. Tax collector
   B. Soldier
   C. Fisherman
   D. Priest

5. What did Jesus say made Bartimaeus well? (1 mark)
   A. His shouting
   B. His cloak
   C. His money
   D. His faith

6. Which is a kind way to help a blind person? (1 mark)
   A. Greet them by name and offer to guide them
   B. Leave them out
   C. Laugh at them
   D. Move their things

7. Which is a way of thanking God? (1 mark)
   A. Praying and singing praise
   B. Complaining
   C. Being rude
   D. Ignoring Him

8. How many men with leprosy met Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Ten
   B. Twelve
   C. Two
   D. Five

9. Which of these is an act of compassion? (1 mark)
   A. Laughing at a friend's loss
   B. Ignoring a lonely child
   C. Teasing a sad friend
   D. Comforting a grieving friend

10. What is a widow? (1 mark)
   A. A queen
   B. A woman whose husband has died
   C. A woman without children
   D. A teacher

11. What does it mean to forgive? (1 mark)
   A. To forget your name
   B. To hide
   C. To stop being angry and not pay the person back
   D. To hit back

12. What does Matthew 5:39 teach? (1 mark)
   A. Do not resist an evil person by taking revenge
   B. Hit back harder
   C. Take what is yours
   D. Ignore everyone

13. What did the woman do when she lost one coin? (1 mark)
   A. Waited
   B. Bought another
   C. Gave up
   D. Lit a lamp, swept the house and searched

14. How many people were baptised on the day of Pentecost? (1 mark)
   A. About three hundred
   B. About thirty
   C. About three thousand
   D. About three

15. Which value do we learn when we plant and water a seed? (1 mark)
   A. Jealousy
   B. Greed
   C. Laziness
   D. Responsibility and patience

16. What did Jesus say a person must be to see the kingdom of God? (1 mark)
   A. A priest
   B. Old
   C. Rich
   D. Born again

17. What does it mean to trust someone? (1 mark)
   A. To fear them
   B. To hide from them
   C. To believe they are honest and will not harm you
   D. To argue with them

18. What did Joseph say about doing the wrong thing? (1 mark)
   A. I do not care
   B. Maybe later
   C. It is fun
   D. How could I sin against God?

19. How should we tell the truth? (1 mark)
   A. With love and respect
   B. To hurt
   C. Loudly
   D. Rudely

20. Why does a truthful person feel peaceful? (1 mark)
   A. They have nothing to hide
   B. They are rich
   C. They are old
   D. They are popular

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. In your own words, what is a parable and why did Jesus use them? (2 marks)

22. Give three ways of turning away from sin and living righteously. (3 marks)

23. Give four benefits of forgiving others. (4 marks)

24. Who was Nicodemus? (2 marks)

25. Why were people with leprosy kept apart in Bible times? (2 marks)

26. State three qualities of good giving. (3 marks)

27. Explain how we can prevent the spread of contagious diseases and how we should treat those who are sick. (5 marks)

28. State two ways in which Bartimaeus showed faith in Jesus. (2 marks)

29. Name two ways of expressing thanks to people who are kind to us. (2 marks)

30. Explain what the parts of the parable stand for. (3 marks)

31. State two things the angel said about John before he was born. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #2 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Luke 1:37
   Luke 1:37 is the memory verse of this topic.

2. C — Gabriel
   Luke 1:26 says God sent the angel Gabriel.

3. D — One who goes before to prepare
   A forerunner goes ahead.

4. D — Priest
   Luke 1:5 says he was a priest.

5. D — His faith
   Jesus said, "Your faith has healed you."

6. A — Greet them by name and offer to guide them
   Kindness and respect help people with disabilities.

7. A — Praying and singing praise
   Praise and prayer express thanks.

8. A — Ten
   Luke 17:12 says ten men met Him.

9. D — Comforting a grieving friend
   Comfort shows care.

10. B — A woman whose husband has died
   A widow has lost her husband.

11. C — To stop being angry and not pay the person back
   Forgiving lets go of revenge.

12. A — Do not resist an evil person by taking revenge
   Jesus taught us to break the cycle of revenge.

13. D — Lit a lamp, swept the house and searched
   Luke 15:8 says she searched carefully.

14. C — About three thousand
   Acts 2:41 says about three thousand.

15. D — Responsibility and patience
   Caring for a plant teaches responsibility.

16. D — Born again
   John 3:3 records this.

17. C — To believe they are honest and will not harm you
   Trust means believing someone is reliable.

18. D — How could I sin against God?
   Genesis 39:9 records his answer.

19. A — With love and respect
   Truth should be told kindly.

20. A — They have nothing to hide
   Truth brings a clear conscience.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: A short story used to teach a lesson about God and life. Stories are easy to remember.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for story and 1 for teaching a lesson.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say sorry to God; be honest; be kind; obey parents; pray and read the Bible.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: Peace, restored friendship, freedom from anger, pleasing God, fewer fights.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid benefit up to 4.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: A Pharisee and a member of the Jewish ruling council who visited Jesus at night.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Pharisee or leader and 1 for visiting Jesus.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: The disease was contagious and people feared it would spread.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for disease and 1 for fear of spread.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Cheerful, quiet, respectful, useful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid quality.

27. (5 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands with soap, keep the environment clean, eat well, visit the clinic and follow the advice of health workers. We should treat the sick with care, kindness and respect and not reject them, as Jesus did.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for hygiene, 1 for clean environment, 1 for clinic advice, 1 for kindness, 1 for not rejecting the sick.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: He called out to Jesus; he kept shouting when told to be quiet; he came at once; he asked for sight.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Say thank you, write a card, help them in return.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: The woman stands for God; the coin stands for a lost person; the joy stands for the joy in heaven when someone repents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid part.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: He would bring joy, be great before the Lord, be filled with the Holy Spirit, and turn many to God. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.
